## Context
- Epic 78f2-b104-e3c9-4b86 (Janitor Cleanup 2026-08-29) requires promoting the review scanner-integration lane from advisory to voting within the Gerrit Verified aggregate.
- Incident 90c7 showed two failure classes to avoid: a vacuous Verified vote where a newly-required job did not run on its own introducing change, followed by a portability defect that made the lane red for every downstream change.
- Promotion is safe now because the advisory lane is landed and validated green on real GitHub Actions (story aa9e-3d35-fd3e-41ee, CL 2666, merge SHA 4c9940348148fb255b17ddf1cb124701ad4565d7, run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33985796177), and bug b973-b298-9b5d-4765 closed the vacuous-vote escape with a predates-gate guard and lane-derived parity coverage on main.

## Scope
- Wire scanner-integration into automatic Gerrit Verified evaluation so it no longer depends on manual dispatch.
- Add scanner-integration to .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml voting needs, vote normalization, and workflow-conclusion aggregation so scanner failure blocks Verified.
- Reverse the ADR-0114 advisory exception in scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py so mirror-vs-Verified parity requires scanner-integration in the voting aggregate.
- Keep GitHub Actions and the Jenkins/mirror path coherent: _scanner-integration.yml, gerrit-verify.yaml, gerrit-scanner-verify.yml/test.yml parity, Jenkinsfile mirror behavior, and POSIX-dash-safe Make target semantics must remain aligned.
- Update required coverage in tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py, tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py, tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py, tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py, and mechanism/parity baselines when a changed assertion proves the promoted behavior.

## Anti-90c7 safety design
- Use the existing b973 predates-gate guard instead of trusting a vacuous vote. The promoted scanner-integration lane must be lane-derived into the guard/parity tests, and this change's own Verified run must show scanner-integration executed and passed before submit.
- The promotion must ensure the lane runs automatically for every Gerrit patchset and that required-workflow aggregation observes its conclusion.
- Portability guardrail: do not introduce bash-only shell options or a GitHub-only path. Keep the Make recipe and mirrored Jenkins/GHA semantics dash-safe and verified by parity tests.

## Testing
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` proves vote routing, workflow naming, parity, and predates-gate coverage.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` proves scanner-integration is required by the voting aggregate and no longer listed as advisory.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` proves formatting, ruff, module-size, complexity, mechanism-delta, and workflow parity gates.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck` proves static typing remains green.
- A sandboxed mutation run removes scanner-integration from the voting aggregate and confirms the held-out parity/predates oracle fails, then restores the production files.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` proves scanner-integration executes automatically on every Gerrit patchset as part of Verified evaluation, not only by manual dispatch.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py` proves gerrit-verify.yaml includes scanner-integration in voting needs, vote normalization, and required workflow-conclusion aggregation; a scanner failure blocks Verified.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` passes only when scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py requires scanner-integration in the voting aggregate and no longer treats it as an ADR-0114 advisory exception.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` proves predates-gate/parity coverage includes scanner-integration and prevents a vacuous vote where the new job did not execute on its own introducing change.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` proves GitHub Actions, mirror test workflow, and Jenkins/mirror path remain coherent and POSIX-dash-safe, preventing the incident-90c7 portability class.
- [ ] `make lint && make typecheck` plus the targeted pytest command above pass locally with `.venv/bin` first on PATH.
- [ ] Gerrit evidence shows LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, and the promoting change's own Verified run contains a non-skipped scanner-integration job that executed and passed before submit.
